authentication.description: Security rules that apply to every member of the CMS staff.
authentication.warningTitle: This setting affects the whole console
authentication.warningText: When multi-factor authentication (MFA) is not required, a stolen password is enough to open the CMS with that person's permissions. Keep it required unless you have a strong reason. Only a platform super admin who has verified their second factor can turn it off, and the change is recorded in the audit logs.

authentication.confirmDisableText: Staff members will be able to sign in to the CMS with only their password. Members who already have a verified factor will still have to use it. This change is recorded in the audit logs.
